title: Do not learn to imitate the abominations of the nations
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same directive as Exodus 23:24 (C0241); it introduces the itemized occult prohibitions of 18:10–11.

title: Do not purify a son or daughter by fire
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Context verse: C1071–C1072 omit this clause; same rite as Leviticus 18:21 (C0590).

title: Do not practise divination
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Context verse: C1071–C1072 cover only spoken omens and sorcery; Rambam's divination ban here is unitemized (C0629 is omen-reading).

title: Do not observe auguries
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Context verse: same Greek verb as Leviticus 19:26 'divine by omens' (C0629); C1071 covers spoken omens only.

title: Be perfect before the Lord your God
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same call as Genesis 17:1 (C0033), here set against diviners. 18:12 is a rationale needing no record.

title: Set apart three cities of refuge in the land
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Repeats Numbers 35:11–15 (C0943); C0946 already links Deuteronomy 19:4–6 to Numbers 35.

title: Set apart three cities of refuge
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Restates 19:2.

title: Add three more refuge cities when God enlarges your borders
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Conditional addition beyond the six cities of Numbers 35; itemized nowhere. 19:10 gives the purpose.

title: Save alive nothing that breathes in the named nations' cities
speaker: the Lord through Moses
recipient: Israel at war in the land
note: Rambam N49 has no record of its own; C0997 (Deuteronomy 7:2, N50) records the same no-sparing judgment.

title: Apply the devotion judgment to the seven named nations
speaker: the Lord through Moses
recipient: Israel at war in the land
note: Rambam P187 missing: C0997 is negative only; C0245 (Exodus 23:33) concerns removal. 20:18 gives the reason.

title: Non-fruit trees may be cut down for siegeworks
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Extend C1100 from 20:19 to 20:19–20: the permitted exception completes the tree law.

title: Do not sow your vineyard with a different crop
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
note: Rambam N216 missing; C0622 (Leviticus 19:19) covers the field (N215), not the vineyard.

title: Treat the yield of a mixed-sown vineyard as forfeit
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
note: Rambam N193 (no eating or use of vineyard mixtures) missing; rests on the 'become consecrated' clause.

title: Do not wear wool and linen woven together
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam N42 is itemized as C0623 (Leviticus 19:19); link Deuteronomy 22:11 there.

title: Make tassels on the four corners of your garment
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same law as Numbers 15:38 (C0860, Rambam P14).

title: Put both adulterer and adulteress to death
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same judgment as Leviticus 20:10 (C0646).

title: Do not take your father's wife
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Same prohibition as Leviticus 18:8 (C0579); Deuteronomy 27:20 also parallels it.

title: Keep the camp holy, with nothing indecent seen
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: C1149's title ('indecency') already draws on 23:15; extend its reference from 23:10 to 23:10, 15.

title: Do not charge your brother interest on any loan
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Lender's ban itemized as C0206 (Exodus 22:24); Rambam N236 as Maimonides reads it (borrowing at interest) has no record.

title: You may lend at interest to a foreigner, not your brother
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P198 missing; the brother clause repeats 23:20 (C0206).

title: Perform what your lips have vowed; declining to vow is no sin
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P94 missing as a general positive: C0930 (Numbers 30:3) is negative; C0826 covers Nazirite vows only.

title: Put to death one who kidnaps and sells an Israelite
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same law as Exodus 21:17 in Saints numbering (C0176).

title: Do not pervert the judgment of the sojourner, orphan or widow
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Context verse: C1177 covers only the widow's pledge; Rambam N280 missing. Deuteronomy 27:19 belongs with it.

title: Remember your slavery in Egypt as the reason for these laws
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Motive command repeated at 24:22 (and 24:20 in Saints); C0116 (Exodus 13:3) is a Passover remembrance.

title: Keep a true and just weight and measure
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Same law as Leviticus 19:36 (C0643, Rambam P208); C1195 covers only the prohibition.

title: Bring firstfruits in a basket to the place God chooses
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: First step of the itemized rite (C1198–C1201); the general law is C0237 (Exodus 23:19, Rambam P125).

title: Recite the ancestral-deliverance declaration over the firstfruits
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P132 is itemized as C1198, but its reference (26:3) omits the recited declaration itself (26:5–10).

title: Give the third-year tithe to Levite, sojourner, orphan and widow
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
note: Same law as Deuteronomy 14:28–29 (C1034, Rambam P130).

title: Keep and do God's statutes with all heart and soul
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Closing charge of the law code, generic obedience as in C0124; a Deuteronomy-specific record is the alternative.

title: Moses and the elders charge Israel to keep all the commandments
speaker: Moses and the elders of Israel
note: The only joint charge by Moses and the elders; compare the 27:9 records for Moses and the priests.

title: Set up and plaster the covenant stones on Mount Ebal
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: C1203's title already names Mount Ebal, which only 27:4 supplies; extend from 27:2 to 27:2, 4.

title: Write all the law very plainly on the stones
speaker: the Lord through Moses
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: C1204's 'clearly' comes from 27:8 ('very plainly'); extend from 27:3 to 27:3, 8.

title: Hear, O Israel, and obey the Lord's voice and commandments
speaker: Moses and the Levitical priests
note: Same speech and verb ('hear… hearken'); M028 duplicates the 27:9 record.

title: Moses orders the tribes stationed on Gerizim and Ebal
speaker: Moses
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Speech formula naming Moses as giver of the station order.

title: Do not make a carved or cast image, even in secret
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
note: Curse form of the image ban (C0147); C1210 records only the people's Amen.

title: Do not dishonour your father or mother
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Curse form of the command to honour parents (C0153).

title: Do not move your neighbour's boundary
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
note: Curse form of Deuteronomy 19:14 (C1084).

title: Do not lead the blind astray on the road
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Curse form of Leviticus 19:14 (C0609).

title: Do not pervert justice for the sojourner, orphan and widow
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
note: Better host: the proposed Deuteronomy 24:17 record (P00504), same wording; C0218 is the general rule.

title: Do not lie with your father's wife
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Curse form of Leviticus 18:8 (C0579).

title: Do not lie with any animal
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
note: Curse form of Leviticus 18:23 (C0593).

title: Do not lie with your sister or half-sister
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Curse form of Leviticus 18:9 (C0580).

title: Do not lie with your mother-in-law
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Curse form of Leviticus 18:17 (C0587).

title: Do not lie with your wife's sister
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
note: Second curse in Saints 27:23; parallels Leviticus 18:18 (C0588).

title: Do not strike your neighbour down treacherously
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Secret, treacherous killing; compare C0173 (Exodus 21:14, killing by treachery).

title: Continue in all the words of this law to do them
speaker: the Levites, proclaiming God's covenant curses
note: General covenant curse, quoted at Galatians 3:10 (no record there).

title: Walk in the Lord's ways
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Rambam P8 has no Deuteronomy record; only C0032 (Genesis 17:1). Also unitemized at 26:17 and elsewhere in Deuteronomy.

title: Do not turn aside from God's words to serve other gods
speaker: the Lord through Moses
note: Prohibition embedded in the blessings; same directive as Deuteronomy 6:14 (C0995). The rest of 28:7–15 is promise.

title: Take heed to do all the words of this covenant
speaker: Moses
note: Generic covenant-keeping charge of the Moab covenant; same directive as C0124.

title: Guard against any heart turning from God to the nations' gods
speaker: Moses
recipient: every man, woman, family and tribe of Israel
note: Broad record names 'reject hidden idolatry'; the 'root of bitterness' is quoted at Hebrews 12:15 (A093). 29:21–24 are predictions.

title: Hidden things belong to God; revealed things are ours to do
speaker: Moses
note: Context verse, not flagged as a candidate; a well-known maxim with no itemized record. 29:27 itself is narrative.

title: The commandment is not beyond reach; the word is near you
speaker: Moses
note: Broad record names 'the word is near'; Romans 10:6–8 quotes it. 30:1–10 are restoration promises (compare C0983).

title: Choose life: love, obey and cling to the Lord
speaker: Moses
note: The two-ways appeal (30:15–20) is one unit; extend C1212 from 30:19.

title: Moses tells Israel to be strong and unafraid in taking the land
speaker: Moses
note: The broad record's 'Be strong' is unitemized; C1213 is the separate charge to Joshua. Hebrews 13:5 cites 31:6.

title: Joshua is charged at the tent to lead Israel into the land
speaker: Moses at the tent commission (the Lord, in the Hebrew)
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: The charge for which Joshua was summoned in 31:14 (C1216–C1217) has no record itself; 31:20–21 are prediction.

title: Moses tells the ark-bearing Levites to place the law beside the ark
speaker: Moses
recipient: the Levites who carry the ark
note: Speech formula naming the addressees; M029 duplicates the 31:26 record.

title: See that the Lord alone is God, who kills and heals
speaker: the Lord, in the Song of Moses
note: Same call as Deuteronomy 4:39 (C0985). 32:40–42 are judgment speech.

title: Take these words to heart and command your children to keep them
speaker: Moses
note: Broad record names 'teach the words to children'; compare C0978 (Deuteronomy 4:9–10). 32:47 gives the motive: 'this is your life'.

title: Moses: go up Mount Nebo and view the land of Canaan
speaker: the Lord
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Repeats Numbers 27:12 (C0922); the death instruction in 32:50 is C1223.

title: Eastern tribes: fight until your brothers have rest, then return
speaker: Joshua, recalling Moses' command
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 1:15 completes the charge with its time limit and the return home.

title: Eastern tribes pledge to obey Joshua as they obeyed Moses
speaker: Reuben, Gad and half-Manasseh
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The pledge begins at 1:16; 1:17's 'let the Lord be with you' is a wish.

title: Rahab asks the spies to show her mercy and faithfulness
speaker: Rahab
note: Rahab renews her request after the spies' pledge ('Our life in place of yours').

title: The spies set Rahab the conditions of their oath
speaker: the two spies
note: Conditions: keep the household inside; do not disclose the agreement. 2:21 is Rahab's assent.

title: Joshua consecrates Jericho's metals to the Lord's treasury
speaker: Joshua
note: Distinct from 6:17 (the ban) and 6:18 (the warning): the metals go into the treasury.

title: Joshua forbids rebuilding Jericho under an oath-curse
speaker: Joshua, by an oath before the Lord
note: A binding oath-prohibition, its fulfilment narrated in the verse; compare C1030 (Deuteronomy 13:17).

title: Remove the banned goods from among you to regain God's presence
speaker: the Lord
note: 7:12 already states the condition: 'unless you remove that which is under the ban'.

title: The Lord decrees burning for the one taken with banned goods
speaker: the Lord
note: Sentence for the ban violation; ot-joshua-v7-14 covers only the identification by lot.

title: Joshua appoints the Gibeonites woodcutters and water-carriers for the altar
speaker: Joshua and Israel's leaders
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 9:27 narrates Joshua's formal appointment, adding service for God's altar.

title: Distribute the land by lot among the tribes
speaker: the Lord
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 'Only distribute it by lot' (13:6) begins the same allotment command.

title: Caleb asks Joshua for the promised hill country
speaker: Caleb son of Jephunneh
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Joshua 14 has no records; 14:6–11 is Caleb's case (14:9 a promise), 14:13 the grant.

title: Joshua tells Joseph's tribes to clear the woodland for themselves
speaker: Joshua
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
note: Joshua first gives the woodland instruction at 17:15; 17:17–18 repeats and expands it.

title: Joshua directs the surveyors to divide the land in seven
speaker: Joshua
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 18:5 adds the survey rule: Judah keeps the south, Joseph the north.

title: Joshua warns Israel not to intermarry with the remaining nations
speaker: Joshua
note: Warning distinct from 23:11 (love the Lord); compare C0998 (Deuteronomy 7:3). 23:14–16 echo 23:6–8.

title: Joshua makes a covenant, gives statutes, and sets a witness stone
speaker: Joshua
note: Covenant ratification with law and judgment (24:25) and a witness stone (24:27); no record covers 24:25–27.

title: Othniel urges Achsah to ask her father for a field
speaker: Othniel
note: Saints Judges reading; in Joshua 15:18 Achsah consults him instead. Caleb's question needs no record.

title: Barak asks Deborah to go with him into battle
speaker: Barak
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Conditional request; Deborah's reply (4:9) is consent and prophecy.

title: Sisera musters his chariots and army at the Kishon
speaker: Sisera
note: Reported muster order; Barak's muster (4:10) is likewise unrecorded.

title: Sisera asks Jael for a little water to drink
speaker: Sisera
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Ordinary request between 4:18 and 4:20, both recorded.

title: Deborah and Barak call Israel to bless the Lord
speaker: Deborah and Barak
note: Call to worship addressed to the people; repeated at 5:9 (outside this batch). 5:3 is Study Context.

summary: Deuteronomy 18-27 holds most gaps (vineyard mixtures, interest to foreigners, vows, 24:17 justice, unlinked repeated laws and Deut 27 curses); Deut 28-34, Joshua and Judges need few records beyond commissions, requests and extensions.
